item: tests: every item (N) that RULINGS_INDEX.md cites resolves to exactly one OPEN_QUEUE.md entry
summary: Measured first: OPEN_QUEUE.md holds 127 entries opening '(N) **' but its numbering restarts between sections, so (1) to (17) each appear several times and only (18) to (30) are unique; RULINGS_INDEX.md cites ten items (20, 21, 26, 28, 29, 30), all of which resolve to one entry. The test therefore pins 'a cited number has exactly one entry' (a missing number and an ambiguous one are both refused) and not contiguity, which would say nothing below 18. Mutants: citing item (99), dropping entry (21) and duplicating entry (28) each turn the resolution test red; renaming the citation phrase turns the reader-liveness test red. Limit stated in the docstring: it checks the entry exists, not that the row's claim about it is true, and only the number right after item or items is read.
